tagline: Leading integrated resort operator in Asia-Pacific with premier properties in Macao and Singapore
hero_kpi_rationale: Capex is the hero KPI as it directly reflects strategic investments in capacity expansion at Marina Bay Sands and Macao, the main growth drivers in a cyclical sector where capacity determines revenue.

kpis.name: Capital investments
kpis.explanation: Amount invested each year in construction and development of new projects.
kpis.description: Capex declined in 2025 to $1.17B versus $1.57B in 2024, primarily due to completion of certain renovation work at Marina Bay Sands and Macao.
kpis.signal: Sharp Capex decline in 2025 following a peak in 2024.

kpis.name: Operating cash flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated by the company's main business activities.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow decreased in 2025 to $3.02B versus $3.20B in 2024, due to a one-time payment of $848 million for the purchase of additional gaming space in Singapore and a decline in Macao.
kpis.signal: Slight decline despite improvement in Singapore.

kpis.name: Financial leverage ratio
kpis.explanation: Measure of net debt relative to gross operating profit, expressed as a multiple.
kpis.description: The leverage ratio in Singapore was 1.37x at end of 2025 versus a contractual limit of 4.50x, indicating solid financial health of Marina Bay Sands.
kpis.signal: Very low leverage in Singapore, well below the contractual ceiling of 4.50x.

kpis.name: Unrestricted cash
kpis.explanation: Amount of cash available for operations or investments without contractual restrictions.
kpis.description: The company held $3.84B of unrestricted cash at end of 2025, of which $2.45B was held by non-US subsidiaries.
kpis.signal: High cash balance, reinforcing financial flexibility and financing capabilities.

kpis.name: Gaming license expiration (Singapore)
kpis.explanation: Expiration date of the gaming license at Marina Bay Sands in Singapore.
kpis.description: The gaming license at Marina Bay Sands was renewed through April 2028 following a $75 million payment in March 2025.
kpis.signal: Regulatory visibility assured through April 2028 following renewal in March 2025.

kpis.name: Total headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: The company employs approximately 25,000 people, primarily in Macao and Singapore.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €21.92B in latest year.

kpis.name: Total debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €15.78B in latest year.

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years 10-K filings.

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Net income of $1.627B in latest year.

kpis.name: Capital investments in Macao
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in development and renovation projects in Macao.
kpis.description: Investments in Macao declined to $555 million in 2025 versus $879 million in 2024, due to completion of certain major projects including The Londoner Grand.
kpis.signal: Marked slowdown in Macao investments in 2025.

kpis.name: Capital investments in Singapore
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in development and renovation projects at Marina Bay Sands.
kpis.description: Investments in Singapore decreased to $574 million in 2025 versus $648 million in 2024, related to room renovations at Marina Bay Sands.
kpis.signal: Marked reduction in construction spending in Singapore.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Total amount paid in dividends per share over the fiscal year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Share of net income redistributed. >80% = potentially unsustainable.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions risks related to cybersecurity and data protection concerning the integrity of its information systems. The gaming and payments sector is particularly vulnerable to cyberattacks.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive gaming and hospitality sector with many major competitors. This creates pricing pressure and may reduce market share.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations on gaming, anti-corruption compliance (FCPA), anti-money laundering, and consumer protection. Any regulatory change could have significant impact.

risks.title: Geopolitics
risks.score_rationale: The company operates primarily in Macao and Singapore, making it vulnerable to geopolitical risks, regime changes, sanctions, or trade tensions affecting Asia-Pacific.

risks.title: Financial
risks.score_rationale: The company maintains a solid financial position with leverage of 1.37x in Singapore and 1.34x on a consolidated basis, well below contractual ceilings. Financing costs remain a factor to monitor.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies is present in LVS's 10-K filing.
